s: Ahura Mazda establishes Mithra (to maintain and look over the moving world)
q: Whom Ahura Mazda has established to maintain and look over all this moving world, and who maintains and looks over all this moving world;

s: Mithra has arms long arms (strong with Mithra-strength)
q: Whose long arms, strong with Mithra-strength, encompass what he seizes in the easternmost river and what he beats with the westernmost river, what is by the Sanaka of the Rangha and what is by the boundary of the earth.

s: Mithra has knowledge a thousand senses (whose ear hears well)
q: who has a thousand senses, and sees every man that tells a lie.

s: Mithra sees every man that tells a lie (with a thousand senses)
q: who has a thousand senses, and sees every man that tells a lie.

s: Mithra possesses chariot (beautiful, golden, and ever-swift)
q: Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, drives forward from the shining Garô-nmâna, in a beautiful chariot that drives on, ever-swift, adorned with all sorts of ornaments, and made of gold.

s: chariot is drawn by white stallions (four, all of the same white colour)
q: Four stallions draw that chariot, all of the same white colour, living on heavenly food and undying.

s: Mithra surveys everything between earth and heavens (after the setting of the sun)
q: Who goes over the earth, all her breadth over, after the setting of the sun, touches both ends of this wide, round earth, whose ends lie afar, and surveys everything that is between the earth and the heavens,

s: Mithra is assisted by Rashnu-Razista (at his right hand)
q: At his right hand drives Rashnu-Razista, the most beneficent and most well-shapen.

s: Mithra is assisted by Kista (at his left hand)
q: At his left hand drives the most upright Kista, the holy one, bearing libations in her hands, clothed with white clothes, and white herself;

s: Kista bears libations (in her hands)
q: At his left hand drives the most upright Kista, the holy one, bearing libations in her hands, clothed with white clothes, and white herself;

s: Mithra is followed by Âtar (all in a blaze)
q: Behind him drives Âtar, all in a blaze, and the awful kingly Glory.

s: Mithra is a god (powerful, all-knowing, undeceivable)
q: the powerful, all-knowing, undeceivable god.

s: Mithra is truth speaking truth-speaking (a chief in assemblies)
q: We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, who is truth-speaking, a chief in assemblies, with a thousand ears, well-shapen, with a thousand eyes, high, with full knowledge, strong, sleepless, and ever awake.

s: Mithra has a thousand ears (truth-speaking and all-knowing)
q: We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, who is truth-speaking, a chief in assemblies, with a thousand ears, well-shapen, with a thousand eyes, high, with full knowledge, strong, sleepless, and ever awake.

s: Mithra has a thousand eyes (truth-speaking and all-knowing)
q: We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, who is truth-speaking, a chief in assemblies, with a thousand ears, well-shapen, with a thousand eyes, high, with full knowledge, strong, sleepless, and ever awake.

s: Mithra possesses club of Mithra (a hundred knots and a hundred edges)
q: Swinging in his hands a club with a hundred knots, a hundred edges, that rushes forwards and fells men down; a club cast out of red brass, of strong, golden brass; the strongest of all weapons, the most victorious of all weapons;

s: Mithra increases creation of Spenta Mainyu (with manifold knowledge and powerfully)
q: Who, with his manifold knowledge, powerfully increases the creation of Spenta Mainyu, and is a well-created and most great Yazata, self-shining like the moon, when he makes his own body shine;

s: Mithra is self shining like the moon (when he makes his own body shine)
q: and is a well-created and most great Yazata, self-shining like the moon, when he makes his own body shine;

s: Mithra is related to Ahura Mazda (as one of two great, imperishable, holy gods)
q: We sacrifice unto Mithra and Ahura, the two great, imperishable, holy gods;

s: Ahura Mazda is related to Mithra (as one of two great, imperishable, holy gods)
q: We sacrifice unto Mithra and Ahura, the two great, imperishable, holy gods;

s: Mithra is lord of countries (all countries)
q: We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of all countries.

s: Mithra is associated with Law of Mazda (ten thousandfold)
q: Mithra is ten thousandfold when connected with the Law of Mazda, and then he will be every day of victorious strength.

s: Law of Mazda is associated with Mithra (ten thousandfold)
q: Mithra is ten thousandfold when connected with the Law of Mazda, and then he will be every day of victorious strength.

s: libations please Mithra (when cleanly prepared and properly offered)
q: Let the faithful man drink of the libations cleanly prepared, which if he does, if he offers them unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, Mithra will be pleased with him and without anger.

s: unholy priest does not please Mithra (not pious and not the Word incarnate)
q: He does not delight Ahura Mazda, nor the other Amesha-Spentas, nor Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, he who thus scorns Mazda, and the other Amesha-Spentas, and Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, and the Law, and Rashnu, and Arstât, who makes the world grow, who makes the world increase.

s: club of Mithra is a weapon (the strongest and most victorious)
q: a club cast out of red brass, of strong, golden brass; the strongest of all weapons, the most victorious of all weapons;

s: Glory is offered Mithra (as a sacrifice worth being heard)
q: For his brightness and glory, I will offer unto him a sacrifice worth being heard, namely, unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures.

s: Mithra is feared by Angra Mainyu (who flees away in fear)
q: From whom Angra Mainyu, who is all death, flees away in fear;

s: Angra Mainyu is a all death
q: From whom Angra Mainyu, who is all death, flees away in fear;

s: Mithra is feared by Aêshma (who flees away in fear)
q: from whom Aêshma, the evildoing Peshôtanu, flees away in fear;

s: Ahura Mazda is a god (supreme in holiness)
q: We worship the holy Sraosha; we worship the great master, Ahura Mazda, who is supreme in holiness, who is the foremost to do deeds of holiness.

s: Sraosha guards the creation of Mazda (never sleeping and wakefully)
q: Who, never sleeping, wakefully guards the creation of Mazda; who, never sleeping, wakefully maintains the creation of Mazda;

s: Sraosha protects material world (with his club uplifted from sunset)
q: who protects all the material world with his club uplifted, from the hour when the sun is down;

s: Sraosha fights Mâzainya Daêvas (every day and every night)
q: who every day, every night, fights with the Mâzainya Daêvas.

s: Sraosha is fearless before Daêvas (he does not bow for fear and fright)
q: He bows not for fear and fright before the Daêvas:

s: Sraosha has body body (the body of the holy Sraosha)
q: We sacrifice unto the body of the holy Sraosha;

s: Sraosha has moments the first, the next, the middle, and the highest (all moments of the holy and strong Sraosha)
q: The first [Sraosha], the next, the middle, and the highest; with the first sacrifice, with the next, with the middle, and with the highest.

s: Ahura Mazda creates Sraosha (as a defense against Aêshma)
q: Whom the holy Ahura Mazda has created to withstand Aêshma, the fiend of the wounding spear;

s: Daêvas fear Sraosha (bowing before him reluctantly)
q: before him all the Daêvas bow for fear and fright reluctantly, and rush away to darkness.

s: Drug is a fiend (fiendish and world-destroying)
q: who smites the fiendish Drug, and is most strong and world-destroying;

s: Drug is turned away by good prayer (as Manly Courage, without deceit and without harm)
q: as good prayer, without deceit and without harm, is Manly Courage, and turns away the Drug.

s: the Law of the worshippers of Mazda is a law (the truest giver of all good things)
q: The Law of the worshippers of Mazda is the truest giver of all the good things, of all those that are the offspring of the good principle;

s: the Law of the worshippers of Mazda is related to the good principle (its good things are offspring of it)
q: The Law of the worshippers of Mazda is the truest giver of all the good things, of all those that are the offspring of the good principle;

s: good prayer is a prayer (excellent and good for the worlds)
q: Good prayer, excellent prayer to the worlds, O Zarathustra!

s: good prayer takes away fiends (taking away their friendship and turning away their faculties)
q: This it is that takes away the friendship of the fiend and fiends, of the he-fiend and of the she-fiend; it turns away in giddiness their eyes, minds, ears, hands, feet, mouths, and tongues;

s: prayer is a ritual utterance (used for propitiation and glorification)
q: Be propitiation, with sacrifice, prayer, propitiation, and glorification.

s: Ahura Mazda teaches Sraosha (teaching the Law)
q: who is the teacher of the Law: he himself was taught it by Ahura Mazda, the holy One.

s: the creation of Mazda is guarded by Sraosha (wakefully and without sleeping)
q: Who, never sleeping, wakefully guards the creation of Mazda; who, never sleeping, wakefully maintains the creation of Mazda;

s: material world is protected by Sraosha (with his club uplifted from sunset)
q: who protects all the material world with his club uplifted, from the hour when the sun is down;

s: worshippers of Mazda obey the laws of Ahura (as confessing worshippers of Mazda)
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: faithful man is rich in good thoughts (in houses protected by Sraosha)
q: as well as the faithful man, rich in good thoughts, rich in good words, rich in good deeds.

s: faithful man is rich in good words (in houses protected by Sraosha)
q: as well as the faithful man, rich in good thoughts, rich in good words, rich in good deeds.

s: faithful man is rich in good deeds (in houses protected by Sraosha)
q: as well as the faithful man, rich in good thoughts, rich in good words, rich in good deeds.

s: Holy Word is a fiend-smiter (the best of all fiend-smiters)
q: the word of truth is the fighter that is the best of all fiend-smiters.

s: Mithra is lord of wide pastures
q: We sacrifice unto the body of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures;

s: Amesha-Spentas may go along Karshvares
q: so that the Amesha-Spentas may go along the seven Karshvares of the earth;

s: Zarathustra is a worshipper of Mazda (a follower of Zarathustra)
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: the law of holiness is a law (the will of the Lord)
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness . . . .

s: Sraosha is a god (holy, strong, incarnate Word, mighty-speared and lordly)
q: Unto the holy, strong Sraosha, who is the incarnate Word, a mighty-speared and lordly god,

s: Sraosha is a master of holiness (holy and tall-formed)
q: We sacrifice unto the holy, tall-formed, fiend-smiting Sraosha, who makes the world increase, the holy and master of holiness.

s: Sraosha maintains and looks over all this moving world
q: Who strikes the evil-doing man, who strikes the evil-doing woman; who smites the fiendish Drug, and is most strong and world-destroying; who maintains and looks over all this moving world;

s: Sraosha is a protector (best protector of the poor)
q: The holy Sraosha, the best protector of the poor, is fiend-smiting; he is the best smiter of the Drug.

s: Ahura Mazda is a holy being
q: O holy Ahura Mazda!

s: Rashnu Razista is strong strong
q: we invoke, we bless Rashnu, the strong.

s: Rashnu Razista is beneficent beneficent
q: O thou, holy Rashnu! O most true Rashnu! most beneficent Rashnu!

s: Rashnu Razista is knowledgeable knowing
q: most knowing Rashnu! most discerning Rashnu! most fore-knowing Rashnu! most far-seeing Rashnu!

s: Rashnu Razista administers justice justice (best doer)
q: Rashnu, the best doer of justice! Rashnu, the best smiter of thieves

s: Rashnu Razista smきes thieves (best smiter)
q: Rashnu, the best doer of justice! Rashnu, the best smiter of thieves

s: Rashnu Razista destroys bandits (uninjured, best killer, smiter, and destroyer)
q: The uninjured, the best killer, smiter, destroyer of thieves and bandits!

s: Rashnu Razista watches men (in whatever part of the world he is)
q: in whatever part of the world thou art watching the doings of men and making the account

s: Holy Word is a most glorious Holy Word
q: The most glorious Holy Word (itself), this is what in the Holy Word is created true, what is created progress making, what is fit to discern, what is healthful, wise, and happy, what is more powerful to destroy than all other creatures.

s: Holy Word is created true true
q: The most glorious Holy Word (itself), this is what in the Holy Word is created true,

s: Holy Word is progress making progress-making
q: what is created progress making,

s: Ahura Mazda has knowledge of everything
q: thou art undeceivable, as thou knowest everything.

s: Holy Word is healthful healthful
q: what is fit to discern, what is healthful, wise, and happy,

s: Holy Word is wise wise
q: what is fit to discern, what is healthful, wise, and happy,

s: Holy Word is happy happy
q: what is fit to discern, what is healthful, wise, and happy,

s: Holy Word destroys all other creatures (more powerfully than)
q: what is more powerful to destroy than all other creatures.

s: Law of holiness is the best of all good
q: Holiness is the best of all good

s: the Law of the worshippers of Mazda is will of the Lord
q: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness

s: var prepared is towards fire
q: towards this var prepared, towards the fire and the baresma, towards the full boiling [milk], towards the var of oil and the sap of the plants;

s: var prepared is towards the full boiling [milk]
q: towards this var prepared, towards the fire and the baresma, towards the full boiling [milk], towards the var of oil and the sap of the plants;

s: var prepared is towards var of oil
q: towards this var prepared, towards the fire and the baresma, towards the full boiling [milk], towards the var of oil and the sap of the plants;

s: Ahura Mazda has undeceivable understanding truth
q: Thou art undeceivable, thou hast an undeceivable understanding;

s: var prepared is towards sap of the plants
q: towards this var prepared, towards the fire and the baresma, towards the full boiling [milk], towards the var of oil and the sap of the plants;

s: Saoka is made by Ahura Mazda
q: Along with the fiend-smiting Wind, along with the cursing thought of the wise, along with the kingly Glory, along with Saoka, made by Mazda.

s: sea Vouru-Kasha contains tree of the eagle (in the middle of the sea)
q: on the tree of the eagle, that stands in the middle of the sea Vouru-Kasha,

s: Hara Berezaiti is a bright mountain (around which the many stars revolve)
q: the Hara Berezaiti, the bright mountain around which the many (stars) revolve,

s: Ahura Mazda comes for help towards var prepared (along with the fiend-smiting Wind, the cursing thought of the wise, the kingly Glory, and Saoka)
q: Then I, Ahura Mazda, shall come for help unto thee, towards this var prepared, towards the fire and the baresma, towards the full boiling [milk], towards the var of oil and the sap of the plants;

s: Hara Berezaiti is free from night
q: where come neither night nor darkness,

s: Hara Berezaiti is free from darkness
q: where come neither night nor darkness,

s: Hukairya is made of gold (highest and possessing deep precipices)
q: upon the highest Hukairya, of the deep precipices, made of gold,

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita is a river (leaping from Hukairya)
q: wherefrom this river of mine, Ardvi Sûra Anâhita, leaps from a thousand times the height of a man,

s: Tistrya is a star (bright and glorious)
q: the bright and glorious star Tistrya,

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull contains Bull (has the seed of the Bull in it)
q: the moon which has the seed of the Bull in it,

s: Zarathustra is a worshipper of Mazda
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: Zarathustra is a follower of Zarathustra
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: Zarathustra hates Daêvas
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: Zarathustra obeys the laws of Ahura
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: Ahura Mazda is described as bright and glorious
q: To Ahura Mazda, bright and glorious, and to the Amesha-Spentas;

s: wisdom acquired through the ear is made by Ahura Mazda
q: To Vohu-Manô; to Peace, whose breath is friendly, and who is more powerful to destroy than all other creatures; to the heavenly Wisdom, made by Mazda, and to the Wisdom acquired through the ear, made by Mazda;

s: Asha-Vahista is a Amesha-Spenta (fairest)
q: We sacrifice unto Asha-Vahista, the fairest, the Amesha-Spenta;

s: instrument made by Mazda is made by Ahura Mazda
q: we sacrifice unto the instrument made by Mazda;

s: Spenta-Ârmaiti is a good being
q: We sacrifice unto the good Spenta-Ârmaiti;

s: Haurvatât is a Amesha-Spenta (master)
q: We sacrifice unto Haurvatât, the Amesha-Spenta;

s: Ahura Mazda is worshipped by worshippers of Mazda
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: fatness is associated with flocks
q: we sacrifice unto fatness and flocks;

s: Gâh Hâvan has associated deity Mithra (at the Gâh Hâvan)
q: (At the Gâh Hâvan): We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures;

s: Mithra is lord of wide pastures
q: (At the Gâh Hâvan): We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures;

s: Âtar is son of Ahura Mazda
q: (At the Gâh Rapithwin): We sacrifice unto Asha-Vahista and Âtar, the son of Ahura Mazda.

s: water is made by Ahura Mazda (holy waters)
q: we sacrifice unto the holy waters, made by Mazda.

s: Verethraghna is made by Ahura Mazda
q: to Verethraghna, made by Ahura, and to the crushing Ascendant.

s: Gâh Usahin has associated deity Sraosha (at the Gâh Usahin)
q: (At the Gâh Usahin): We sacrifice unto the holy, tall-formed, fiend-smiting Sraosha, who makes the world grow, the holy and master of holiness;

s: Sraosha is a holy being (tall-formed, fiend-smiting, master of holiness)
q: (At the Gâh Usahin): We sacrifice unto the holy, tall-formed, fiend-smiting Sraosha, who makes the world grow, the holy and master of holiness;

s: Sraosha makes grow world
q: (At the Gâh Usahin): We sacrifice unto the holy, tall-formed, fiend-smiting Sraosha, who makes the world grow, the holy and master of holiness;

s: Amesha-Spentas is a all-ruling, all-beneficent beings
q: we sacrifice unto the Amesha-Spentas, the all-ruling, the all-beneficent.

s: Daêvas are hated by worshippers of Mazda
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: Yâtus include Daêvas
q: Let the Yâtus be crushed, O Zarathustra! both Daêvas and men.

s: the Law of the worshippers of Mazda is worshipped by worshippers of Mazda
q: We worship the Law of the worshippers of Mazda;

s: Law of Mazda is carried away as prisoner
q: and he takes away the Law of Mazda, that was carried away as a prisoner, from the hands of the [ungodly], who are destroyed by his strength.

s: waters coming in the shape of a horse are made by Ahura Mazda
q: we worship the waters coming in the shape of a horse, made by Mazda.

s: trespasses and faults are renounced by Zarathustra (all)
q: he has renounced all trespasses and faults, O Zarathustra!

s: destroyer of Vohu-Manô and his words is thrown down by Zarathustra (with a hundred times hundredfold, with a many times manifold preaching and smiting)
q: when he throws down the destroyer of Vohu-Manô and his words, with a hundred times hundredfold, with a many times manifold preaching and smiting,

s: Amesha-Spentas is described as all-beneficent
q: we sacrifice unto the Amesha-Spentas, the all-ruling, the all-beneficent.

s: Yathâ ahû vairyô states Law of holiness (the will of the Lord)
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness . . . .

s: Ashem Vohû states Law of holiness (holiness is the best of all good)
q: Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good. . . .

s: sacrifice is offered to Hâvani (with prayer, propitiation, and glorification)
q: For sacrifice, prayer, propitiation, and glorification unto [Hâvani], the holy and master of holiness . . . .

s: prayer is offered to Ahura Mazda (with sacrifice, propitiation, and glorification)
q: I bless the sacrifice and the prayer, the strength and vigour Of Ahura Mazda, bright and glorious, and of the Amesha-Spentas;

s: Law of holiness is the will of Ahura Mazda
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness . . . .

s: Glory are given to man (as a blessing)
q: Give unto that man brightness and glory, give him health of body, give him sturdiness of body, give him victorious strength of body, give him full welfare of wealth, give him a virtuous offspring, give him long, long life, give him the bright, all-happy, blissful abode of the holy Ones.

s: Vohu-Manô is a Amesha-Spenta
q: We sacrifice unto Vohu-Manô, the Amesha-Spenta;

s: heavenly Wisdom is made by Ahura Mazda
q: To Vohu-Manô; to Peace, whose breath is friendly, and who is more powerful to destroy than all other creatures; to the heavenly Wisdom, made by Mazda, and to the Wisdom acquired through the ear, made by Mazda;

s: Ardibehist Yast is a Yast
q: III. Ardibehist Yast.

s: Asha-Vahista is increased by hymns of praise
q: That thou mayest increase Asha-Vahista, O Spitama Zarathustra! with hymns of praise, with performance of the office, with invocations, holy words, sacrifice, blessings, and adoration—once to abide in the shining luminous space, in the beautiful abodes—for the sacrifice and invocation of us, the Amesha-Spentas' . . . .

s: Asha-Vahista is increased by sacrifice
q: That thou mayest increase Asha-Vahista, O Spitama Zarathustra! with hymns of praise, with performance of the office, with invocations, holy words, sacrifice, blessings, and adoration—once to abide in the shining luminous space, in the beautiful abodes—for the sacrifice and invocation of us, the Amesha-Spentas' . . . .

s: Asha-Vahista has Glory
q: For his brightness and glory I will offer unto him a sacrifice worth being heard, namely, unto Asha-Vahista, the fairest, the Amesha-Spenta.

s: Amesha-Spentas have shining luminous space (as an abode)
q: once to abide in the shining luminous space, in the beautiful abodes—for the sacrifice and invocation of us, the Amesha-Spentas

s: Amesha-Spentas have beautiful abodes (as abodes)
q: once to abide in the shining luminous space, in the beautiful abodes—for the sacrifice and invocation of us, the Amesha-Spentas

s: Garô-nmâna is a abode (of Ahura Mazda)
q: (Easy is the way to the Garô-nmâna of Ahura Mazda): the Garô-nmâna is for the holy souls

s: Garô-nmâna is for holy souls
q: the Garô-nmâna is for the holy souls

s: Garô-nmâna has bright, wide, holy ways
q: and no one of the wicked can enter the Garô-nmâna and its bright, wide, holy ways

s: wicked cannot enter Garô-nmâna
q: no one of the wicked can enter the Garô-nmâna and its bright, wide, holy ways

s: Angra Mainyu is a Daêva (all death and worst-lying of all Daêvas)
q: Angra Mainyu, who is all death, the worst-lying of all Daêvas, rushed from before him

s: Airyaman prayer is a spell (greatest, best, fairest, fearful, firm, victorious, and healing)
q: It is the greatest of spells, the best of spells, the very best of all spells; the fairest of spells, the very fairest of all spells; the fearful one amongst spells, the most fearful of all spells; the firm one amongst spells, the firmest of all spells; the victorious one amongst spells, the most victorious of all spells; the healing one amongst spells, the best-healing of all spells.

s: Airyaman prayer is a remedy (best-healing of all remedies)
q: amongst all remedies this one is the healing one that heals with the Holy Word; this one it is that will best drive away sickness from the body of the faithful: for this one is the best-healing of all remedies.

s: Holy Word heals sickness (from the body of the faithful)
q: amongst all remedies this one is the healing one that heals with the Holy Word; this one it is that will best drive away sickness from the body of the faithful: for this one is the best-healing of all remedies.

s: Law of holiness is a good (best of all)
q: Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good . . . .

s: Yênhê hâtãm is a prayer
q: Yênhê hâtãm: All those beings of whom Ahura Mazda knows the goodness . . . .

s: Ahura Mazda speaks to Zarathustra (as teacher)
q: Ahura Mazda spake unto Spitama Zarathustra, saying: 'That thou mayest increase Asha-Vahista, O Spitama Zarathustra!

s: Ashemaogha is a unholy being
q: the unholy Ashemaogha fled away, the oppressor of men fled away.

s: Snake brood is smitten by Airyaman prayer
q: He smites the brood of the Snake;

s: Wolf brood is smitten by Airyaman prayer
q: he smites the brood of the Wolf

s: Two-legged brood is smitten by Airyaman prayer
q: he smites the brood of the Two-legged.

s: pride is smitten by Airyaman prayer
q: He smites Pride;

s: scorn is smitten by Airyaman prayer
q: he smites Scorn

s: hot fever is smitten by Airyaman prayer
q: he smites Hot Fever

s: slander is smitten by Airyaman prayer
q: he smites Slander

s: Ahura Mazda keeps Amesha-Spentas (with Good Thoughts, Good Words, and Good Deeds)
q: which Ahura Mazda keeps with Good Thoughts, which Ahura Mazda keeps with Good Words, which Ahura Mazda keeps with Good Deeds;

s: discord is smitten by Airyaman prayer
q: he smites Discord

s: Evil Eye is smitten by Airyaman prayer
q: he smites the Evil Eye.

s: falsehood is smitten by Airyaman prayer (most lying words)
q: He smites the most lying words of falsehood

s: Drug perishes regions of the North (never more to give unto death the living world of the holy spirit)
q: The Drug will perish away, the Drug will perish; the Drug will rush, the Drug will vanish. Thou perishest away to the regions of the North, never more to give unto death the living world of the holy spirit.

s: sacrifice is offered to Asha-Vahista (for his brightness and glory)
